The '''Shroud's production facility''' was the headquarters of [[The Shroud (Human)|the Shroud]]'s [[The Shroud's syndicate|organization]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. It was locatedin the [[Network Security District]] of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="TOR:TSLS" />
